verdict.line: Buy. A 3-bed here at about $2,630 psf is at or below what the closest competitors' 3-bed-size resales support (about $2,630 psf as a new launch). 3-bed and 4-bed are the most wanted sizes in this mixed own-stay and rental area.
reasons: The closest competitors (Clavon, The Clement Canopy, Seahill, The Vision, Hundred Trees) work out to about $2,630 psf as a brand-new launch, after adding 5% where they were not built under the harmonised floor-area rules, a 33% new-launch premium (what launches selling now in the OCR charge over their closest resale, 12 launches).

Clavon (121 m away, 640 homes, completed 2024): its 3-bed-size resales (about 790 to 1,060 sq ft) averaged $2,249 psf over the last 12 months (5 resales), against a median $2,159 psf for all sizes. A 3-bed here at about $2,628 psf is $379 psf (+17%) above that; a 3-bed there sold for a median $2.68M.

The newest land bid nearby, Dover Drive (GLS) (1,823 m, $1,556 psf ppr), is 24% above this site's land cost. It breaks even at about $2,570 psf, and analysts expect it to launch at $2,800-2,900+ (CBRE, PropNex).
Bought at the current average $2,628 psf, the base case makes about +12% after stamp duty and selling costs by 2030 (3.0% a year); bought at $2,630 psf it makes about +12%.

Who can buy a 3-bed from you (tested at today's $2.43M; about $2.91M by 2030 in the base case): HDB 5-room upgraders yes; HDB 4-room upgraders yes; Landed owners right-sizing no; Condo owners nearby moving or upgrading yes. Resale pool: wide.

compsNote: 2 of the 5 competitors are within 1 km. Near-twins come first: up to two condos within 1.5 km with a similar number of homes (half to double) completed in 2016 or later. Then every suitable condo within 1 km (same tenure, completed 2011 or later first), widening to 2 km and 3 km only if fewer than 3; executive condos are left out. Resale prices are URA medians for the last 6 months where there were at least 5 resales, otherwise the last 12 months. Condos launched before June 2023 measured their areas under the old rules (including air-con ledges), so their psf is raised 5% to compare like for like.
priceDecide: Like for like by size: for each unit type we take each resale competitor's average psf for units within about 15% of that size (last 6 months, or 12 or 24 if too few). Each is raised by the 33% new-launch premium that launches selling now in the OCR carry over their closest resale (12 launches). Buy at or below = the average of the competitors' new-launch equivalents for that size; walk away above = 5% more. 3-bed: buy at or below $2,630, walk away above $2,760, this project about $2,628 psf; 4-bed: buy at or below $2,660, walk away above $2,790, this project about $2,505 psf. This project's price by unit type is from the developer's caveats.  The developer breaks even at about $2,160 psf (EdgeProp's method); launches since 2023 priced on average 27% above break-even, which points to about $2,750 psf.

exit.mopNote: HDB 4-room and bigger flats completed from 2021 that reach their 5-year minimum occupation period by about 2030, in the towns resale buyers come from (HDB Property Information, data.gov.sg). New MOP flats add fresh upgraders.
exit.note: How we test each buyer group, in today's money (prices, HDB values and incomes tend to rise together): the unit at today's current average price; a 25% down payment plus Buyer's Stamp Duty; HDB upgraders put their flat's sale proceeds in first (median resale price, minus an illustrative $150,000 loan). The group can buy if that capital covers the down payment and stamp duty; the income the remaining 30-year loan needs (tested at 4% under the 55% TDSR) is shown against SingStat's 2025 averages by home type, excluding employer CPF (4-room $11,097, 5-room and executive $13,887, condo $22,006). HDB resale prices rose 4.2% a year over the past 10 years, so upgraders' capital usually grows too. Singaporean HDB owners who buy before selling pay 20% Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty upfront and get it back only if they sell the flat within 6 months (IRAS).
exit.line: In this mixed own-stay and rental area, the 3-bed resale pool is wide; the 4-bed resale pool is good.

fplans.note: Main layout per bedroom type (most units where counts are published), redrawn from the developers' plans in the Stacked Homes directory. Score out of 10, same rules for every plan: start at 4; +1 regular shape, dumbbell, kitchen that can be closed off, kitchen or yard window, AC ledge and planter under 5%, store or shelter or utility room; −1 long corridor, ledge and planter 10% or more, balcony over 12%. Efficiency = the share of the area not taken by AC ledges, planters, bay windows and corridors. Plans under the 2023 rules exclude AC ledges from the strata area, so their sq ft is all usable.
